name: Pod Stuck in Pending (Insufficient Resources)
expected_symptoms: Event: 0/N nodes are available: insufficient cpu, insufficient memory
Pod never gets scheduled to a node
root_cause: The pod is requesting 8 CPU cores and 32Gi of memory, which exceeds the capacity of any node in the cluster. The scheduler cannot find a suitable node.
fix_steps: Reduce the resource requests to reasonable values, e.g., cpu: '100m' and memory: '128Mi'.
fix_hint: Use kubectl patch to update the Deployment resource requests. Example: kubectl patch deployment pending-app -n oncall-bench --type strategic -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"app","resources":{"requests":{"cpu":"100m","memory":"128Mi"}}}]}}}}'
confirm_commands: kubectl get pod -l app=pending -n oncall-bench -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.phase}'
